entries.title: Civic access and Editorial Studio reliability repaired
entries.summary: The public login and citizen-profile presentation were refined while the private Editorial Studio's ticker controls were repaired. Login now shows password-length readiness directly, keeps its action red until the ten-character requirement is met, and turns green only to indicate local readiness rather than credential validity. Civic breadcrumbs are compact, and the certificate uses the Society's established interlocking-ring mark. Editorial updates now cross the Worker's CORS boundary correctly, report success or failure beside the active control, retain attempted form content after a failed save, and state the five-minute public-refresh window. No ticker content, civic account, or authorization rule was changed by this release. All 77 release tests passed before publication.
entries.subjectName: Civic Access and Private Editorial Studio

changes: Reduced the login and public-profile breadcrumb band height
Added explicit ten-character password readiness feedback
Changed the login action from red to green only when the local password-length requirement is met
Clarified that local readiness does not verify whether a password is correct
Replaced the loose certificate-circle construction with the established interlocking Society mark
Added PATCH to the Worker's CORS allow-methods response
Moved Editorial Studio success and error messages beside the active control
Preserved unsaved ticker, source, and weather form content when an update fails
Explained the five-minute public ticker refresh window after successful changes
Preserved server-side Founder authorization and made no civic-record or ticker-content mutation
